---
name: Release change
about: Prepare a reviewable release and rollback
title: 'Change: '
labels: change
---

## Goal and scope

Environment, owner, release window, commit and image digest/tag.

## Evidence and risk

Checks, integration result, scan result, dependencies, data/schema compatibility,
backup identifier, expected impact and approval.

## Execution and rollback

Ordered deployment steps, abort criteria, compatible previous version and rollback
commands. State which actions affect data.

## Verification and handover

Health/readiness, fresh order lifecycle, metrics, final outcome, open issues and
next responsible operator.
